reviews.text: It was my first time visiting SUA Glow. They are sweet and attentive. PA Sophia was detail oriented and I felt safe receiving treatment from her. I usually go to bigger cities like Los Angeles to get any Korean skin treatment done but I will revisit SUA Glow for my next treatment. Thank you Sophia!
My wife had treatment here and recommended me. Great service and great results!
Great experience with Sua Glow. Sophia is very thorough in explaining all the procedures.  The staff is great , I left feeling and looking good.  Highly recommend coming here .

I got the Glass Skin Premium Facial with the needle-free skin booster and water drop lifting, and I'm so happy with the results. My skin felt hydrated, smooth, and noticeably brighter right after.

Sophia did my consultation and took the time to understand my skin concerns and recommend the right treatment. Kelly performed the facial and was gentle, professional, and detail-oriented. The needle-free booster was comfortable and relaxing, and the water drop lifting left my skin feeling fresh and firm.

I'd highly recommend this place, and I'll definitely be back!

I did quite a bit of research before finding Sua. I was frustrated with my skin’s dullness and pore texture and decided it was time to try something more advanced and Korean-style, rather than just microneedling.

I first reached out through Instagram DM and got so much helpful information in response to all my questions (and I had quite a few!). Their attentive and thoughtful response already made a great impression, even before I had become a client.

My consultation with Sophia was very thorough. I decided to go with Oligio X, an advanced skin booster with Re20 (which, as far as I know, they are the only ones carrying), and Skin Tox.

I spent about three hours there and could easily have stayed longer for the post-treatment care, but unfortunately had to leave.

Overall, one of the best clinic experiences I’ve had. They don’t rush you, they don’t try to sell you treatments you don’t need, and they genuinely make sure you’re comfortable throughout the process.

Looking forward to going back next month! 🥰

I finally found the secret to Korean glass skin in DFW and it requires ZERO needles. 💉🚫✨

Honestly, if you’ve been wanting that dewy, lit-from-within Seoul glow without the pain or downtime of injections, you need to check out Sua Glow Medical Aesthetics in Carrollton. I got to experience their Korean facial rituals, and my skin has literally never looked this hydrated or sculpted!

I had a great experience with Sophia! She performed my subcision treatment and took excellent care of me throughout the process. She went above and beyond by taking the extra time to explain the procedure, my treatment options, and answer all my questions. She made me feel comfortable and well-informed. I truly appreciate her professionalism and attention to detail. I highly recommend Sophia!

I had a great experience at Sua Glow! I got Botox with Sophia, and she was so nice, welcoming, and professional. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel very comfortable throughout the appointment. I really appreciated how knowledgeable and patient she was. I would definitely recommend Sua Glow!

Ultimate K-beauty is finally here! ✨ I had such a great experience. The consultation was very professional and thorough, with detailed explanations and personalized recommendations based on my features, preferences, and beauty goals. The prices are
reasonable, and they also offer great promotions. If you’re looking for professional, personalized K-beauty services, I highly recommend this place!

I also want to mention that she's extremely knowledgeable about facial anatomy and is constantly educating herself, both here and in Korea, on best practices and keeping her clients comfy! She's also extremely thorough. But I think what separates her from a lot of other people in the industry is that her priority is safety. There was a treatment I brought up that she was honest with me wasn't the best fit for my specific goals, even though it would have benefited her to just say yes. The fact that shes willing to tell me that let me know she has my best interest at heart.

Side note: They have little salmon plushies for Rejuran procedures in case it's painful for you (should be named Regina or Reggie for Rejuran imo😄).
